The '''Albrae-Don system''' was located in the [[Sern sector/Legends|Sern sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the astronomical object [[Albrae-Don/Legends|Albrae-Don]], which had a [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] on its surface.<ref name="GNN" />

At some point after the date [[1 ABY/Legends|36:10:4]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|10|Galaxywide NewsNets}} establishes that the [[Attack on the Pica Rim Pipeline|bombing of the Pica Rim Pipeline]] occurred at some point after the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of [[Earnst Kamiel]], which {{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}} dates to [[1 ABY/Legends|36:10:4]].</ref> the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|183|Justice Action Network (2)}}</ref> known as the [[Justice Action Network]] carried out a [[Attack on the Pica Rim Pipeline|bombing]] of the [[Pica Rim Pipeline]], an [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Monorail/Legends|monorail]] [[Train/Legends|train]] [[Transit tube|transit tunnel]] on Albrae-Don. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the bombing, a monorail in the tunnel was carrying approximately 4,000 passengers and workers.<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Albrae-Don [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
